content: In this paper we aim to create a system that can understand car-speak based on some natural language input (we want to recreate the dealer from above). But how do we prepare a proper training set for a Natural Language model? What model is best suited to this problem? Can this model take a human out of the car-buying process? To answer these questions, the remainder of this paper makes the following contributions:
